# Lumen Design System

> Warp's design system for freight logistics SaaS. Dark-first, operator-density,
> Spring Green (#00FA8A) on obsidian (#0D0D0D), Satoshi typeface, dual-mode
> (restrained | expressive), LLM-first MD-driven, DTCG 2025.10 tokens, shadcn
> registry. v0.13.0 — Phase 0 foundation reset in progress; v0.12.6 token names
> and component contracts preserved verbatim (additive, not destructive).

This file is the agent-readable index. Fetch one section at a time; each section
points to specific MD or JSON files that an agent can load to resolve a query.
Do NOT load the whole repo as context — load the master briefing, the AGENTS
digest, then the specific foundation / token / component files relevant to the
task.

## Read first

- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md) — universal agent rules + the 19 hard rules. Read first.
- [CLAUDE.md](/CLAUDE.md) — Claude-specific addenda (MCP hints, skill priority, voice).
- [doc/LUMEN-v0.13-MASTER-REFACTOR.md](/doc/LUMEN-v0.13-MASTER-REFACTOR.md) — canonical v0.13 refactor briefing (modes, DTCG, shadcn registry, MCP, gpt-image-2).
- [USING-LUMEN.md](/USING-LUMEN.md) — comprehensive end-to-end manual (every tier, every consumption surface, every governance rule).
- [README.md](/README.md) — human-facing front door.

## Tokens — DTCG 2025.10 (primitives → semantic → modes → components)

### Primitives
- [Color](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/color.tokens.json) — 11 obsidian + 10 neutral + 10 spring + 10 lumen-red + 10 lumen-amber + alpha ramps + Phase 0 alias namespace
- [Dimension](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/dimension.tokens.json) — 4-pt spacing/sizing scale + named off-grid exceptions
- [Spacing](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/spacing.tokens.json) — v0.13 NEW. 10-stop structural ladder + named exceptions catalog
- [Radius](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/radius.tokens.json) — 9 stops xs through 4xl + full
- [Typography](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/typography.tokens.json) — Satoshi family / weight / size / leading / tracking + OpenType features + code.fallback
- [Elevation](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/elevation.tokens.json) — 6 standard shadows + accent-glow + glow-accent (3-layer) + glass + focus
- [Motion](/design-system/01-tokens/primitives/motion.tokens.json) — 5 durations + 6 easings + 2 springs + atmosphere presets

- [Color (light)](/design-system/01-tokens/semantic/color.light.tokens.json) — surface/text/border/action/status/aurora for light mode

- [Surface](/design-system/01-tokens/semantic/surface.tokens.json) — v0.13 Phase 0 split. 8 surface roles + glass-strong
- [Text](/design-system/01-tokens/semantic/text.tokens.json) — v0.13 Phase 0 split. Primary/secondary/tertiary/accent/inverse + state variants
- [Border](/design-system/01-tokens/semantic/border.tokens.json) — v0.13 Phase 0 split. Hairline/default/strong/frame/accent/focus + state variants
- [Action](/design-system/01-tokens/semantic/action.tokens.json) — v0.13 Phase 0 split. 5 canonical intents + variants
- [Space](/design-system/01-tokens/semantic/space.tokens.json) — semantic spacing aliases
- [Type](/design-system/01-tokens/semantic/type.tokens.json) — typography role composites
- [Motion](/design-system/01-tokens/semantic/motion.tokens.json) — semantic motion presets

(Phase 2 lands the @lumen shadcn registry; one folder per registry item under `02-components/<name>/` with `<name>.md` + `<name>.skill.md` + `<name>.tsx` + `<name>.registry.json` + `<name>.stories.tsx`.)

## MCP (Phase 6 lands — `/design-system/07-mcp/`)

- Install: `claude mcp add --transport http lumen https://lumen.warp.dev/mcp`
- Tools: `list_components`, `get_component`, `get_tokens`, `search`, `install`, `get_prompt_template`
- shadcn consumer config: [`components.json`](/components.json) (root)
- shadcn registry manifest: [`registry.json`](/registry.json) (root, Phase 2 fills)

## Hard rules (must follow — see AGENTS.md for the full prose)

1. Never invent tokens. Always reference semantic, never primitives.
2. Every component ships `component.json` + (Phase 2) `<name>.skill.md`.
3. WCAG 2.2 AA hard floor. `prefers-reduced-motion` + `prefers-reduced-transparency` honored.
4. Spring Green (`#00FA8A`) is the only loud color. Action / live / success only. Never decorative.
5. White on accent surface ≈ 1.4:1 — AA fail. Use `color.accent.fg` (`#07120D`) or `.lumen-btn-*` defensive classes.
6. Floating UI portals to `document.body`. Never inline `<div absolute>`.
7. Focus rings ride `outline + box-shadow`, never box-shadow alone.
8. Position math via inline `style`, not Tailwind arbitrary classes.
9. Version labels import from `lib/version.ts`, never hardcoded literals.
10. `<details>`/`<summary>` accordions with custom chevron get `class="lumen-summary"`.
11. v0.13 — Mode is a scope attribute, never a per-component prop.
12. v0.13 — `backdrop-filter` only on floating shells (popover, sheet, command palette, nav, hero device frame). NEVER on canvas, data table, row, cell.
13. v0.13 — DTCG 2025.10. `$value` + `$type` + `$description` on every token. Alias syntax `{token.path}`. No hex literals outside primitives.
14. v0.13 — Phase 0 alias namespace (`color.obsidian/spring/lumen-red/lumen-amber`) is first-class but additive. v0.12.6 names preserved verbatim.
15. v0.13 — Vercel AI Elements naming for AI primitives (Conversation, Message, Reasoning, Tool, Sources, InlineCitation, PromptInput, Suggestion, Confirmation, Artifact, WebPreview, Agent). Anthropic Citations API JSON shape for citation UI.
16. v0.13 — gpt-image-2 generates atmosphere, NEVER icons. Snapshot-pin `gpt-image-2-2026-04-21` in every prompt. Open every prompt with `@import 05-prompts/style-anchor.md`.

## Operating context

- Repo: github.com/NeelMyno/Warp-Lumen-Design-Guidelines
- Live preview: https://warp-lumen-design-guidelines.vercel.app
- Build: `pnpm tokens` → `dist/` (v0.13; was `_build/` pre-v0.13)
- Audit: `pnpm audit:contrast` → `tools/audit-baseline/contrast-{restrained,expressive}.json`
- Version: see `/VERSION` (currently `0.13.0`) and `/audit-dashboard/src/lib/version.ts`
